companionGroups.description: Every companion group among the manifest's bills, complete on every response (full, windowed, snapshot), sorted by primaryGuid. [] = no groups (or disabled); field absent = server predates companion groups.

updatedAt.description: When something last happened to the bill: the processed bill's storedAt at its first publication or at its latest news (a status change, an action newer than its latest or another on that day, or a new text version). A reprocess, a re-summary of the same text or a change to its details (cosponsors, member votes, committees, older actions, topics, life areas) keeps it (since 2026-10-28).

subCategories.description: The processed bill's sub-category labels, except that a ceremonial resolution (one that designates a day or week, or recognizes, honors or congratulates someone) has none (since 2026-10-29). Until the label switch ends (Phase E) a bill may still carry the legacy names Social Justice and Identity Politics, which clients show as Civil Rights and Liberties and Heritage and Identity.

lifeAreas.description: The processed bill's life areas, except that a ceremonial resolution (one that designates a day or week, or recognizes, honors or congratulates someone) has none.

sponsors.description: Bioguide IDs, copied from the processed bill.

cosponsors.description: Bioguide IDs, copied from the processed bill: every Congress.gov cosponsor since REL-28, only the first 20 on a bill fetched before it (see the processed bill's cosponsors).

voteCount.description: Deprecated: no longer sent (INT-11). A vote count is other users' votes, which nobody sees before voting on the bill; clients must not show or sort by it. Kept optional so older builds keep decoding.
